passerby.emotions: male 52 yo, breathing heavily, very worried

dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Oh God, I've finally gotten through. Send someone over here.
Sir, what's your emergency?
The Collins', my neighbors' house. . . it's literally fallen apart. . . collapsed. . . I don't know what to do. . .
{IS ANYONE INSIDE?} Were your neighbors inside?
I think so...
{ARE YOU SURE?} You think so or they were? This is really important, we have a lot of emergencies.
They were. Uhmmm... I saw Jane and Susan for sure, probably with the little kid, I have no idea about the rest of the family.
{HOW MANY PEOPLE?} Ok, how many people live in the house?
Six, but Ted surely went to work in the morning.
{SO, FIVE PEOPLE?} So if Ted's gone to work there could be five people in the house?
{WHO LIVES THERE?} So who would be in the house and what are their ages?
A woman, two children. . . or three, Rose is older though, she's in college. And Su, their grandmother, she's 65.
{HAS IT ALL COLLAPSED?} Has the house completely collapsed?
Yes, there's only a single wall fragment left.
{CAN YOU HEAR THEM?} Can you hear anything from under the rubble, voices, somebody calling up for help?
I don't know. I had waited a while after the earthquake stopped. Then I looked out the window and saw that and started calling you immediately.
{YOU HAVE TO HELP} Ok, listen, they need you to help.
Like how?
{TAKES TIME TO GET THERE} It might take a while before the fire department and ambulance can get there.

{LOOK FOR THEM} What I need you to do is, as soon as we're off this phone call, go over to the collapsed house, but don't walk on the rubble, ok? Maybe you can manage to figure out where the rescuers should start looking for people. Help them find them faster. But if you smell gas stay out of the area.
Okay, got it.
{CALL OTHERS} You can try to get the other neighbors to start removing the rubble.
Okay, anything else?
{WAIT FOR THE SERVICES} Please wait for the fire and ambulance to arrive.
I'll do as you said.
{ADDRESS?} What's the address for that house?
Their house is at [[ADDRESS]]
Their house is at Columbus Avenue 246
Their house is at Oak street 135
Their house is at 7th street 89
Are you there?
What am I supposed to do?

reportElement.texten: A house has collapsed with a family inside.
The emergency unit had easier access to injured people, thanks to neighbors who had started removing a rubble.
The caller found a possible location of the injured people.
The operator decided to send an ambulance and firefighters unit.
